description:
Set the voiceover voice for every clip in a project, or only for the clips in `clip_ids`.

Use this to apply a clueprint's voice (read `voiceover.voice.name` and `voiceover.voice.engine` from the clueprint source data), or to switch all clips to a specific voice in one call. When the user names specific clips, pass their ids in `clip_ids` so the other clips keep their voice. The voice is looked up by name + engine; lookup is case-insensitive on the name.

Common engines: 'eleven' (ElevenLabs), 'cartesia', 'google'.

ElevenLabs voices use the latest voice generation unless `voice_version` says otherwise. Leave it unset; pass "legacy" ONLY when the user explicitly asks for the legacy/older voice generation.

clip_ids.description: Clip ids to change the voice on. Omit to change EVERY clip in the project.

voice_name.description: Voice name as stored in the voices table (e.g. 'Alex', 'Sofia')

voice_version.description: ElevenLabs voice generation. Leave unset (latest). Use 'legacy' ONLY when the user explicitly asks for the legacy/older voice generation; never choose it yourself. Ignored for non-ElevenLabs voices.

name: set_voice
title: Set voice
